name: M5.Lift.modulus_multiple
statement: ∀ E N : ℕ, E ∣ N → M5.cyclicModulus E ∣ M5.cyclicModulus N
context:
theorem M5.Lift.cyclic_as_sub : ∀ N : ℕ, M5.cyclicModulus N = (Polynomial.X : M5.BinaryPolynomial) ^ N - 1 := by
  change ∀ N : ℕ, M5.cyclicModulus N = (Polynomial.X : M5.BinaryPolynomial) ^ N - 1
  intro N
  simp [M5.cyclicModulus, sub_eq_add_neg, CharTwo.neg_eq]
guidance: Rewrite using M5.Lift.cyclic_as_sub, then pow_sub_one_dvd_pow_sub_one. No squarefree assumption. Return tactic lines without a leading by. This is a conditional lemma in section 5, not the full M5 theorem.
